citation.authors: Souza JFT, Monico-Neto M, Tufik S, Antunes HKM
citation.title: Sleep Debt and Insulin Resistance: What's Worse, Sleep Deprivation or Sleep Restriction?

population.description: Twenty-three healthy, physically active young men completed the study (28 recruited; Methods, Results). Age 18-40 was the enrolment criterion (no range printed for those studied). Total-sample age and BMI are Table 1 (mean +/- SD, 26.2 +/- 4.1 y and 24.9 +/- 3.1 kg/m2). Two randomised groups: SD (n=10) and SR (n=13), each doing a regular-sleep night and a sleep-debt condition at least a week apart. Group age and BMI are per protocol (SD 23.7 +/- 1 y, 23.74 +/- 3.18 kg/m2; SR 28.23 +/- 4.51 y, 25.90 +/- 2.73 kg/m2, Results text). Healthy: no family history of diabetes and no diabetes or impaired glucose tolerance (Introduction, Methods).

protocols.name: sd_regular
protocols.description: SD group (n=10), regular-sleep condition: in bed 23:00-07:00 (printed 'regular sleep (11 pm to 7 am)'; minutes 0-479 asleep); blood collection and OGTT at 08:00 (minute 540, printed 'blood collection was performed at 8 am'): 75 g anhydrous glucose in 300 mL water at minute 540, blood at minutes 540, 570, 600, 630, 660. The paper prints only 'at least 8 hours of fasting' before the OGTT (a lower bound, not a last-meal time): the last meal is assumed at the arm start, 23:00 (prefast_hours 0, assumed), 9 h before the draw, which satisfies the bound.

meals.food: 75 g anhydrous glucose in 300 mL water

protocols.name: sr_regular
protocols.description: SR group (n=13), regular-sleep condition: in bed 23:00-07:00 (printed; minutes 0-479 asleep); blood collection and OGTT at 08:00 (minute 540): 75 g anhydrous glucose in 300 mL water at minute 540, blood at minutes 540, 570, 600, 630, 660. As for sd_regular: 'at least 8 hours of fasting' is a lower bound, the last meal is assumed at 23:00 (prefast_hours 0, assumed).

left_out.what: insulin through the OGTT (Table 2, both groups and conditions) and baseline insulin (Table 3): unit printed literally as 'ulU/mL', not read as microunits
glucose and insulin AUC at baseline (Table 3, e.g. glucose AUC 376.7 +/- 16.7): no unit and no sampling window printed
HOMA-IR and Matsuda ISI at baseline (Table 3, Results): derived indices from glucose and insulin

SR group, sleep-restriction condition after four nights of 4 h in bed at home (Table 2 'Sleep debt' SR columns; Table 3 SR 'Debt' column for FFA and cortisol; Discussion FFA rise of about 35%): the days between the nights were not standardized and their meals are not printed

sleep-deprivation night (SD group, Sleep debt): OGTT glucose curve (Table 2), baseline FFA and cortisol (Table 3). The paper prints a 24 h deprivation with fasting from 23:00 and 'meals were not allowed' but not when the 24 h or the fast began, so the fast before the 08:00 draw may be 9 h or much longer; FFA in particular depends on it
